children: Samsung partners with Solana to bring cross-border USDC payments to 82 million Galaxy devices on October 8, 2026. The partnership expands stablecoin use on smartphones, with payments routed through Solana.

The partnership extends Solana's stablecoin payment reach to Samsung's Galaxy device base, connecting cross-border transfers with smartphone use. Solana provides the network through which these USDC payments move, expanding its role in payments beyond the announcement of a partnership alone. The stated device reach describes the scope of the integration, not realized payment activity. Actual transaction volume and the resulting network fee impact are not yet established by the announcement.
